text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in building and delivering polished, effective digital work.

I’d be glad to help with your YouTube channel in the AI niche. Since you’ll be providing the voiceover and script, I can focus on turning that material into videos that are eye-catching, entertaining, and clearly relevant to your audience. I understand the importance of keeping AI content visually engaging while still making the message easy to follow and enjoyable to watch.

Although my background is in machine learning and NLP, I’m comfortable working with content that needs structure, clarity, and a modern presentation style. I bring a detail-oriented mindset and a strong sense of what makes information feel smooth, professional, and compelling. For AI-related videos, that means supporting the script with visuals, pacing, and editing choices that match the topic and hold viewer attention.

I work confidently with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. That technical background helps me understand AI content deeply, which is useful when producing videos for this niche. I can help make sure the final result feels aligned with the subject matter and the tone of the channel.

What I can offer:
- Clean and engaging video editing
- Strong pacing to match voiceover narration
- Visual choices that keep AI content interesting
- A professional final output suitable for YouTube
- Careful attention to detail and consistency

I’m comfortable adapting to your style and making revisions to get the pacing and presentation right. If you’re looking for someone reliable who can take your script and voiceover and turn them into videos that feel polished and engaging, I’d be happy to work with you.

Thanks for your consideration — I’d love the chance to support your channel.
